description: This file defines the public API for cellular network drivers in the Zephyr project, including enums, structures, and inline functions for configuring networks, retrieving supported networks, signal strength, and modem info.

methods.name: cellular_configure_networks
methods.description: Configures cellular networks for a device using the provided network configurations.

methods.name: cellular_get_supported_networks
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported cellular networks for a device.

methods.name: cellular_get_signal
methods.description: Gets the signal strength of the cellular device for a specified signal type.

methods.name: cellular_get_modem_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about the cellular modem, such as IMEI, model ID, manufacturer, firmware version, IMSI, or ICCID.
